name: strike-workflows
description: Pre-built DOT workflows for common UI generation scenarios

items.name: Quick Sequential
items.description: Fast straight-through workflow for simple UI generation. No pauses, no approval gates.
items.author: Pamacea
items.dot:
digraph QuickSequential {
  graph [goal="Generate UI quickly"]
  start [shape=Mdiamond]
  analyze [shape=box, prompt="Analyze prompt for anti-patterns"]
  constrain [shape=box, prompt="Select creative constraints"]
  build [shape=box, prompt="Build the UI"]
  exit [shape=Msquare]

  start -> analyze -> constrain -> build -> exit
}

items.name: Step-by-Step Approval
items.description: Pause at each phase for user review and approval. Interactive workshop style.
items.author: Pamacea
items.dot:
digraph WithApproval {
  graph [goal="Generate UI with approval gates"]
  start [shape=Mdiamond]
  analyze [shape=box, prompt="Analyze prompt"]
  analyze_review [shape=hexagon, label="Review Analysis?"]
  constrain [shape=box, prompt="Select constraints"]
  constrain_review [shape=hexagon, label="Review Constraints?"]
  build [shape=box, prompt="Build UI"]
  exit [shape=Msquare]

  start -> analyze -> analyze_review
  analyze_review -> constrain [label="[A] Approve"]
  analyze_review -> analyze [label="[R] Revise"]
  constrain -> constrain_review
  constrain_review -> build [label="[A] Approve"]
  constrain_review -> constrain [label="[R] Revise"]
  build -> exit
}

items.name: Parallel Exploration
items.description: Generate multiple design directions in parallel, then merge and select best approach.
items.author: Pamacea
items.dot:
digraph ParallelExploration {
  graph [goal="Explore multiple directions"]
  start [shape=Mdiamond]
  analyze [shape=box, prompt="Analyze prompt"]
  split [shape=component]
  option_a [shape=box, class="creative", prompt="Direction A: Typography-focused"]
  option_b [shape=box, class="creative", prompt="Direction B: Layout-focused"]
  option_c [shape=box, class="creative", prompt="Direction C: Color-focused"]
  merge [shape=tripleoctagon]
  select [shape=box, prompt="Select best approach"]
  build [shape=box, prompt="Build selected approach"]
  exit [shape=Msquare]

  start -> analyze -> split
  split -> option_a
  split -> option_b
  split -> option_c
  option_a -> merge
  option_b -> merge
  option_c -> merge
  merge -> select -> build -> exit
}

items.name: Adaptive with Retry
items.description: Build UI, validate, and if anti-patterns detected, retry with different constraints.
items.author: Pamacea
items.dot:
digraph AdaptiveRetry {
  graph [goal="Ensure quality with retries"]
  start [shape=Mdiamond]
  analyze [shape=box, prompt="Analyze prompt"]
  constrain [shape=box, prompt="Select constraints"]
  build [shape=box, prompt="Build UI"]
  validate [shape=diamond, label="Valid?"]
  reconstrain [shape=box, prompt="Adjust constraints"]
  exit [shape=Msquare]

  start -> analyze -> constrain -> build -> validate
  validate -> exit [label="No anti-patterns"]
  validate -> reconstrain [label="Anti-patterns found"]
  reconstrain -> build
}

items.name: Teaching Mode
items.description: Generate explanations and diagrams at each phase. Educational workflow.
items.author: Pamacea
items.dot:
digraph TeachingMode {
  graph [goal="Teach the process"]
  start [shape=Mdiamond]
  analyze [shape=box, prompt="Analyze and explain"]
  explain_analysis [shape=box, prompt="Explain anti-pattern detection"]
  constrain [shape=box, prompt="Select and explain constraints"]
  explain_scoring [shape=box, prompt="Explain constraint scoring"]
  build [shape=box, prompt="Build and explain decisions"]
  diagram [shape=box, prompt="Generate explanation diagram"]
  exit [shape=Msquare]

  start -> analyze -> explain_analysis -> constrain -> explain_scoring -> build -> diagram -> exit
}
